an3.130:1.1: āyasmā anuruddho yenāyasmā sārīputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sārīputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
an3.130:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā anuruddho āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
an3.130:1.3: idhāhaṃ āvuso sārīputta dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sahassaṃ lokaṃ olokemi
an3.130:1.4: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ
an3.130:1.5: atha ca pana me nānupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatīti.
an3.130:2.1: yaṃ kho te āvuso anuruddha evaṃ hoti
an3.130:2.2: ahaṃ dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sahassaṃ lokaṃ olokemīti idante mānasmiṃ
an3.130:2.3: yampi te āvuso anuruddha evaṃ hoti
an3.130:2.4: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekagganti idante uddhaccasmiṃ
an3.130:2.5: yampi te āvuso anuruddha evaṃ hoti
an3.130:2.6: atha ca pana me nānupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatīti idante kukkuccasmiṃ
an3.130:2.7: sādhu vata āyasmā anuruddho ime tayo dhamme pahāya ime tayo dhamme amanasikaritvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharatūti.
an3.130:3.1: athakho āyasmā anuruddho aparena samayena ime tayo dhamme pahāya ime tayo dhamme amanasikaritvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃhāsi.
an3.130:3.2: athakho āyasmā anuruddho eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an3.130:3.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
an3.130:3.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā anuruddho arahataṃ ahosīti. 132
